2.3.3 Report.Author
The Report.Author element specifies the name of the author of a Report. This element is optional. If
this element is present, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1).
Following is the parent element of the Report.Author element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.Author element.
 <xsd:element name="Author" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
